# Keeping a sourdough starter

A starter is flour and water left to ferment until wild yeast and bacteria take over the jar.

## Feeding

Discard half, then add equal weights of flour and water. In a warm kitchen feed it daily; in the fridge, once a week.

## Ready to bake

It is ready when it doubles within six hours and smells sour but pleasant. A spoonful floats in water.
